rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona and compact ICM reasonably well, but hedges against the provided 3AA grade and adds uncertain image-specific details about TE looseness/irregularity that may not be reliably visible from a single image.

Integrates maternal age, BMI, prior miscarriage/no pregnancy, male factor, partner age, endometrial thickness, and oocyte yield into prognosis appropriately, though AMH is unavailable and some links (e.g., obesity impact magnitude) are somewhat generic.

Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies: it references euploid and untested probabilities in multiple ranges and ultimately settles on 20–30%, which feels somewhat conservative for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst without fully reconciling the earlier higher estimates.

Generally aligns with IVF practice: acknowledges morphology limits, supports single embryo transfer, luteal support, and selective consideration of PGT-A and sperm DNA fragmentation testing. Minor deviations include speculative comments like avoiding NSAIDs and broad RPL workup after only one miscarriage.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle modification, review of prior cycle data, cavity/RPL evaluation, and male-factor refinement. Useful, though not highly protocol-specific.
